links.outcome: Availability of formal channels for nurses to report AI-related patient safety concerns
links.effect: Of 424 nurses who encountered an AI safety concern, 83 (19.6%) reported no formal channel; non-hospital nurses had higher odds of no channel (OR 2.54; 95% CI 1.54-4.19).
links.quote: Among 424 nurses who encountered an AI-related patient safety concern, 83 (19.6%) reported no formal channel for reporting it.

links.outcome: Presence of a designated mechanism for end users to report AI anomalies
links.effect: 83 of 424 nurses (19.6%) with an AI-related safety concern had no formal reporting channel; odds were 2.54 times higher in non-hospital settings.
links.quote: Among 424 nurses who encountered an AI-related patient safety concern, 83 (19.6%) reported no formal channel for reporting it.

screen.reason: National cross-sectional survey examining the availability and correlates of formal AI patient safety incident reporting channels among practicing nurses.
